key_insight: Agent World Model (AWM) is a fully synthetic environment generation pipeline that produces scalable, diverse, and interactive worlds for agentic reinforcement learning—enabling effectively unlimited environments (e.g., 1,000+ everyday scenarios) with rich toolsets for multi-turn agent interactions.
problem_solved: Addresses the scarcity and limited diversity of reliable training environments that hinder scaling and robust evaluation of autonomous agents.
method: Automated synthetic environment generation pipeline that constructs diverse everyday scenarios at scale.
Integration of rich, interactive toolsets and standardized agent-environment APIs so agents can perform multi-turn tool use and interactions.
Scalable instantiation and quality controls to ensure variety and reliability across hundreds to thousands of generated environments.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a low-cost, high-diversity source of training and evaluation environments to accelerate development of robust, generalist agents and reproducible agentic RL research.
visual_elements: Pipeline flowchart showing generation → toolset integration → agent interaction → validation loop
Grid of sample synthetic environments illustrating scenario diversity (home, office, outdoor, retail, etc.)

Bar/scale chart comparing dataset size and diversity (real-world benchmarks vs. AWM synthetic scale)
paper_title: Agent World Model: Infinity Synthetic Environments for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper_authors: Zhaoyang Wang, Canwen Xu, Boyi Liu, Yite Wang, Siwei Han
